name: Darkwhisper Gorge
summary: Demons hold Darkwhisper Gorge in the southern heights of Winterspring. They fled there after Archimonde fell and now guard its minerals and planar relics.

sections.title: A Legion Foothold in the Snow
sections.body:
In Winterspring's southern heights, demons have made Darkwhisper Gorge their refuge. After Archimonde fell atop Mount Hyjal, the survivors scattered into the mountain ranges. A disciplined vanguard settled here and made the border a stronghold.

Hederine demons lead the foothold under Lady Hederine. Manastalkers, slayers, and initiates defend the tunnels and fiery camps. At the gorge's lowest point, a sealed archway hints at passages higher into the sacred mountain.

sections.title: Hidden Reagents and Rare Knowledge
sections.body:
Danger has not kept adventurers and opportunists from the gorge's wealth. Its ravines hold truesilver and dense thorium deposits. In the shadowed grottos, the imp vendor Vi'el sells fel-tainted reagents such as felcloth and gromsblood.

The elusive high elf Earthcaller Franzahl holds ancient metallurgical lore about smelting rare elementium.

faq.q: Why are there so many demons in Winterspring?
aliases: where did the demons come from
faq.answer: Demons in Darkwhisper Gorge survived the Burning Legion's invasion of Mount Hyjal during the Third War. After Archimonde fell at the World Tree, his broken forces retreated into the chasms to regroup.

faq.q: What is the sealed gate at the back of the gorge?
faq.answer: A runed archway and an active magical barrier stand deep in the gorge's southern depths. They guard a mountain pass leading straight to Mount Hyjal. Travelers reach the mountain's Tainted Foothills by flying from Everlook.
The Hederine, a sect of demonic invaders, dominate the encampment under Lady Hederine's apparent command. They patrol the ravines with slayers, initiates, and fell hounds called manastalkers.

faq.q: Why would an adventurer venture into Darkwhisper Gorge?
faq.answer: Darkwhisper Gorge is exceptionally dangerous, and groups must work together to cross it safely. Warlocks seek planar bindings, priests hunt the rare Eye of Shadow, and blacksmiths and miners seek rich thorium veins. Scholars come looking for Earthcaller Franzahl.

angles.text: Hederine demons in these caverns hold vital planar components. The gorge tests warlocks who seek mastery of greater summoning rituals such as the Doomguard.
The perilous chasms hold abundant truesilver and rich thorium veins. Miners brave enough to slip past elite demons can reach them.
